# drawer_rail

> A Flutter widget for side navigation: one `DrawerRail` that is a full-width panel (search, section labels, a selected pill, text/count badges, inline-expandable groups) and collapses into a narrow icon rail where groups open as flyout menus. State lives in a plain `ChangeNotifier`, `DrawerRailController`; every size, color, text style, icon, cursor and animation is on `DrawerRailTheme`, with `ColorScheme` fallbacks. It can open and close on hover (web/desktop) without overwriting the persisted collapsed state. No runtime dependencies beyond Flutter. Flutter 3.32 or later.

Install with `flutter pub add drawer_rail` and import `package:drawer_rail/drawer_rail.dart`. Key facts:

- Place `DrawerRail(controller: ..., entries: [...])` in a `Row` beside the content, not in `Scaffold.drawer`: it renders at a fixed width and animates it.
- Entries are `DrawerSection` (a header; a divider in the rail), `DrawerLink` (`id`, `icon`, `label`, `onTap`, optional `badge`, `selectedIcon`, `danger`) and `DrawerGroup` (a link list; inline in the panel, a flyout in the rail).
- `controller.collapsed` is the pinned state to persist; `controller.railCollapsed` is what is on screen, which hover can change temporarily.
- `DrawerRailTheme.hoverAdaptive()` makes the rail open on hover and close on exit; `selectOnTap: false` plus `controller.select(id)` lets a router drive the selection.
- `DrawerRailLabels` localizes every built-in string; `DrawerRailController(accordion: true)` keeps one group open at a time.
